passages.context: The complete note was read: the opening recital that from the times of Saint Paul VI to the most recent conversations held at the Dicastery the many attempts to bring the adherents of the movement begun by Archbishop Lefebvre to full communion proved vain, and that the recent consecrations configured the delict of schism, with the citation of Ecclesia Dei n. 3; the four operative statements introduced by 'A tale riguardo, d'ora in poi' concerning sacred ministers (can. 1364 s. 1), lay faithful formally adhering under the conditions of the 1996 note of the Pontifical Council for Legislative Texts 'ancora vigente, che questo Dicastero fa propria', the illicit administration of the sacraments with penance and marriage declared invalid, and the provision for apostolic nuncios to supply procedures to ordinaries; the exhortation to remain in communion citing Lumen gentium 22 and can. 751 and to abstain from the Society's celebrations and activities; the dating and the three signatures.

work.author: Dicastery for the Doctrine of the Faith
work.description: The explanatory note of 2 July 2026, protocol N. 99/2009, published with the penal decree of the same date. It records that attempts at reconciliation from the time of Paul VI to the most recent conversations have proved vain, that the recent consecrations constituted the delict of schism, and declares that from now on the sacred ministers of the Society of Saint Pius X are in schism and subject to the excommunication of canon 1364 s. 1; that lay faithful who formally adhere under the conditions of the 1996 note of the Pontifical Council for Legislative Texts, which the Dicastery makes its own, are schismatic and excommunicated; that the Society's sacred ministers administer the sacraments illicitly and that penance administered by them and marriage assisted by them are invalid; that apostolic nuncios will provide procedures for ordinaries receiving those who return; and that the faithful are exhorted to remain in communion and to abstain from the Society's celebrations and activities.
work.title: Explanatory note of the Dicastery for the Doctrine of the Faith on the Society of Saint Pius X (2 July 2026)
